name: shm-orbital-logistics
title: Orbital Logistics
author: Shahimat
description: Depots and cargo with a destination for space platforms, on top of the vanilla 2.1 platform-to-platform transfers. Mark request groups in the hub panel as reserve, cargo for chosen planets, or a depot for chosen orbits. Reserve is never given away, cargo is held until its destination, a depot serves platforms in its orbits. Keep its request source on «Planet»: sources «Platforms» and «All» never give to platforms. Supply lines keep one item list for a chain of depots, shuttles and landing pads.
